_comment: Copy to <instance>/config/keeper_rules.json. Each key under applies_to is a ruleset name you pass to `fantasy_index.py sync-draft-history --ruleset <name>`; the first one is the default for imports that don't name one. Never apply one league's ruleset to another league.

league_a.note: cost = previous draft round - 2; waiver/FA pickup enters at round 13

league_b.note: cost = previous draft round - 1; undrafted valued at round 17, so cost 16
